arq_turret_quad500.method: Conservative native gunhouse convex decomposition by actual reflex-edge face planes. Disjoint plane-arrangement cells must have their centroid and every inset vertex inside the actual closed housing; merge only exactly convex adjacent unions. Cap at24 largest pieces; closed outward triangular faces in native asset meters. Retain at most24 largest disjoint solids; shrink around a certified interior center for quantization safety, then reject any solid crossed by an actual housing boundary triangle. Verify positive volume, outward face winding, two-face manifold edges, centroid and inset vertices inside the original closed housing.
arq_turret_quad500.coverageNotes: Actual closed concave central gunhouse component1 only. Excludes turntable0, circular elevation actuators3/4, all barrels, raised cradle appendages, hatches and decorative attachments, and all actual underside/side support voids. Same source housing as pd_turret_small, traced through asset.axisScale=[1.9811555555555556, 1.8437210849746009, 2.4615115845212037] and decomposed from the final quantized meter-space vertices. Deliberately omits remaining tiny concave/bevel fragments after the24-piece runtime budget; volumeM3 is only the retained disjoint gunhouse solids. Quantization-safe conservative inner cores; volumeM3 is the sum of retained disjoint closed solids only.

isd_heavy_twin.method: Conservative actual-mesh interior Delaunay cells; reject every cell crossed by a housing boundary triangle; merge only adjacent unions whose convex-hull volume equals the sum of their disjoint cells. Outward closed triangular faces in native asset meters. Retain at most24 largest disjoint solids; shrink around a certified interior center for quantization safety, then reject any solid crossed by an actual housing boundary triangle. Verify positive volume, outward face winding, two-face manifold edges, centroid and inset vertices inside the original closed housing.
isd_heavy_twin.coverageNotes: Conservative interior of actual closed left/right breech houses (components0/2) and authored central rear/middle/front shell components12/10/11. Only their planar four-edge missing floor openings are capped. Rear/middle/front solids use disjoint X partitions at−7 and−1.5m to prevent overlapping credit. Excludes platform13, turntable14, side actuator/armor appendages1/3/4/8, roof fittings5/6/7/9, all barrels and all open support gaps. Quantization-safe conservative inner cores; volumeM3 is the sum of retained disjoint closed solids only.
